2109993575345717714.en_summary: @RedDogT3 says the $SNDK sell signal got him out of all semis on Friday. This morning he may look for a broken bounce against a level. He adds that active traders exit when the 8/21-day averages break, and $SNDK lost its 50-day on Friday.
2109993575345717714.zh_summary: @RedDogT3 表示，$SNDK 的賣出訊號讓他在週五退出了所有半導體持倉。今早他可能會在某個價位尋找反彈失敗的機會。他補充，靠積極交易為生的人在 8 日和 21 日均線跌破時就應離場，而 $SNDK 週五已跌破 50 日均線。
